jem_summary: Collect a genuinely stored egg from an occupied Chicken Coop.

pages.title: The Clucking Store
pages.text: Collect a genuinely stored egg from an occupied Chicken Coop.

pages.title: The Clucking Store
pages.text: Collect farm produce from a working Coop.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Lead compatible chickens into the Coop and let them lay an egg. A Pitchfork releases the birds; placing an empty block does not prove production.

pages.title: Collect coop eggs
pages.text: An occupied Chicken Coop stores eggs. Right-click to collect them; a Pitchfork releases its chickens. The objective requires genuinely produced eggs.

pages.title: Choose species-specific animal feed
pages.text: Cat Food, Dog Food, Horse Fodder and Chicken Feed serve different animals. Their tooltips describe taming, combat, running or jumping, and egg or feather production; there is no universal feed.
